input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The issue describes a timezone problem where users in Sydney receive the Monday summary email on Tuesday, while London users get it on Monday as expected. The file src/notifications/rollup.ts handles the weekly rollup email logic, including scheduling and sending, so it is the most likely place where the timezone calculation or scheduling is off and causing the delayed email dispatch.
